## create summary stats table for regression vars

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(here)

#====================================================
# Function: export_desc_stats_latex
#====================================================
# vars_spec: a list of lists, each with:
#   - col:   column name in df
#   - label: bold label text e.g. "Acreage enrolled"
#   - units: units string e.g. "acres" (or NULL)
#   - comment: TRUE/FALSE to comment out the row (default FALSE)

export_desc_stats_latex <- function(df, vars_spec, file_path,
                                    caption = NULL, label = "tab:desc_stats") {

  # ── Format numbers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fmt_num <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) return("--")
    if (abs(x) >= 1000) {
      formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
    } else if (abs(x) >= 10) {
      formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ",")
    } else {
      formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")
    }
  }

  # ── Build each row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  rows <- lapply(vars_spec, function(v) {

    col     <- v$col
    label_v <- v$label
    units   <- if (!is.null(v$units)) v$units else NULL
    comment <- if (!is.null(v$comment) && v$comment) "%" else ""

    vals <- df[[col]]
    vals_clean <- vals[!is.na(vals)]

    mean_v <- fmt_num(mean(vals_clean))
    sd_v   <- fmt_num(sd(vals_clean))
    min_v  <- fmt_num(min(vals_clean))
    max_v  <- fmt_num(max(vals_clean))
    n_v    <- formatC(length(vals_clean), format = "d", big.mark = ",")

    # Variable label cell
    if (!is.null(units)) {
      var_cell <- paste0("\\textbf{", label_v, "} (", units, ")")
    } else {
      var_cell <- paste0("\\textbf{", label_v, "}")
    }

    row_str <- paste0(
      comment,
      var_cell, " & ", mean_v, " & ", sd_v, " & ",
      min_v, " & ", max_v, " & ", n_v, " \\\\"
    )

    row_str
  })

  body_rows <- paste(unlist(rows), collapse = "\n")

  # ── Caption ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  caption_txt <- if (is.null(caption)) "" else caption

  # ── Full table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  latex <- paste0(
"\\small
\\begin{table}[htbp]
\\centering
\\begin{tabular}{p{7cm}rrrrr}
\\toprule
\\textbf{Variable} & Mean & Std.\\ Dev. & Min & Max & N \\\\
\\midrule
", body_rows, "
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\caption{", caption_txt, "}
\\label{", label, "}
\\end{table}
\\normalsize"
  )

  writeLines(latex, file_path)
  message("Exported: ", file_path)
}

#====================================================
# Example usage
#====================================================
vars_spec <- list(
  list(col = "Net.Reporting.Level.Amount",    label = "PRF-RI enrolllment",    units = "acres"),
  list(col = "DM_mean", label = "Drought exposure",    units = "mean DM classification"),
  list(col = "loss_ratio_raw",  label = "Cost ratio",   units = "indemnities/premia"),
  list(col = "RI_payout_pct", label = "PRF-RI payout %", units = "% grid-intervals w payout")
)

export_desc_stats_latex(
  df        = tpu_collapsed,
  vars_spec = vars_spec,
  file_path = here("data/outputs/tables/desc_stats_regression.tex"),
  caption   = "Descriptive statistics for regression variables. Each observation is a unique county-year with non-zero enrollment",
  label     = "tab:desc_stats"
)



```






## run fixed effects regression
```{r}
library(fixest)

# ── Version 1: Loss ratio only ────────────────────────────────────────────────
m_year_lr <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_state_lr <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year + State.Code,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_county_lr <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year + county_id,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year,
  cluster  = ~county_id
)

# ── Version 2: RI payout % only ───────────────────────────────────────────────
m_year_ri <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(RI_payout_pct, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_state_ri <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(RI_payout_pct, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year + State.Code,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_county_ri <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(RI_payout_pct, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year + county_id,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year,
  cluster  = ~county_id
)

# ── Version 3: Both variables ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
m_year_both <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1) +
              l(RI_payout_pct, 1)
  | year,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_state_both <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1) +
              l(RI_payout_pct, 1)
  | year + State.Code,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_county_both <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1) +
              l(RI_payout_pct, 1)
  | year + county_id,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year,
  cluster  = ~county_id
)

# ── Shared dict ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
reg_dict <- c(
  "l(loss_ratio_raw, 1)"                       = "Lagged Loss Ratio",
  "l(RI_payout_pct, 1)"                        = "Lagged RI Payout \\%",
  "l(DM_mean, 1)"                              = "Lagged Drought Intensity",
  "l(loss_ratio_raw, 1):l(DM_mean, 1)"         = "Lagged Loss Ratio $\\times$ Drought"
)

# ── Preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
etable(m_year_lr,   m_state_lr,   m_county_lr,   digits = 5)
etable(m_year_ri,   m_state_ri,   m_county_ri,   digits = 5)
etable(m_year_both, m_state_both, m_county_both, digits = 5)

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
etable(
  m_year_lr, m_state_lr, m_county_lr,
  file   = here("data/outputs/tables/regression_table_lr.tex"),
  tex    = TRUE,
  label  = "tab:enrollment_lr",
  title  = "Effect of Loss Ratio and Drought on Enrollment",
  digits = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict   = reg_dict,
  drop   = "year|State.Code|county_id"
)

etable(
  m_year_ri, m_state_ri, m_county_ri,
  file   = here("data/outputs/tables/regression_table_ri.tex"),
  tex    = TRUE,
  label  = "tab:enrollment_ri",
  title  = "Effect of RI Payout Rate and Drought on Enrollment",
  digits = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict   = reg_dict,
  drop   = "year|State.Code|county_id"
)

etable(
  m_year_both, m_state_both, m_county_both,
  file   = here("data/outputs/tables/regression_table_both.tex"),
  tex    = TRUE,
  label  = "tab:enrollment_both",
  title  = "Effect of Loss Ratio, RI Payout Rate, and Drought on Enrollment",
  digits = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict   = reg_dict,
  drop   = "year|State.Code|county_id"
)

```

## percent changes in enrollment
```{r}
# ── Exact percent changes from county FE model ────────────────────────────────
coefs <- coef(m_county_lr)

pct_change <- function(beta) round((exp(beta) - 1) * 100, 2)

# Individual effects
beta_lr  <- coefs["l(loss_ratio_raw, 1)"]
beta_dm  <- coefs["l(DM_mean, 1)"]
beta_int <- coefs["l(loss_ratio_raw, 1):l(DM_mean, 1)"]

cat("=== Exact percent changes (county FE model) ===\n\n")

cat("Lagged Loss Ratio (1-unit increase):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_lr), "%\n\n")

cat("Lagged Drought Intensity (1-unit increase in DM):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_dm), "%\n\n")

cat("Lagged Drought Intensity (DM 0 -> 2, moderate drought):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_dm * 2), "%\n\n")

cat("Lagged Drought Intensity (DM 0 -> 4, exceptional drought):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_dm * 4), "%\n\n")

cat("Interaction (loss ratio=1, DM=1 jointly):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_lr + beta_dm + beta_int), "%\n\n")

cat("Interaction (loss ratio=1, DM=2 jointly):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_lr + beta_dm * 2 + beta_int * 2), "%\n\n")

cat("Interaction (loss ratio=1, DM=4 jointly):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_lr + beta_dm * 4 + beta_int * 4), "%\n\n")
```



## maps for county-level regressions (faded for significance)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(tigris)

# ── Settings ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
aoi_states <- unique(tpu_collapsed$State.Abbreviation)
min_obs    <- 5
sig_level  <- 0.10   # threshold for "significant"

# ── Run county-level regressions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
county_models <- tpu_collapsed %>%
  arrange(county_id, year) %>%
  group_by(county_id) %>%
  filter(n() >= min_obs) %>%
  group_map(~ {
    tryCatch(
      lm(ln_enroll ~ lag(loss_ratio_raw) + lag(DM_mean), data = .x),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }, .keep = TRUE)

county_ids <- tpu_collapsed %>%
  arrange(county_id, year) %>%
  group_by(county_id) %>%
  filter(n() >= min_obs) %>%
  group_keys() %>%
  pull(county_id)

# ── Extract coefficients ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
county_coefs <- map2_dfr(county_models, county_ids, function(mod, cid) {
  if (is.null(mod)) return(NULL)
  tidy(mod) %>%
    filter(term %in% c("lag(loss_ratio_raw)", "lag(DM_mean)")) %>%
    mutate(county_id = cid)
})

# ── Pivot wide: one row per county, one col per coefficient ───────────────────
county_coefs_wide <- county_coefs %>%
  select(county_id, term, estimate, p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = term,
    values_from = c(estimate, p.value),
    names_glue  = "{.value}__{term}"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    coef_lr  = `estimate__lag(loss_ratio_raw)`,
    coef_dm  = `estimate__lag(DM_mean)`,
    pval_lr  = `p.value__lag(loss_ratio_raw)`,
    pval_dm  = `p.value__lag(DM_mean)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_lr = pval_lr <= sig_level,
    sig_dm = pval_dm <= sig_level,
    # Cap extreme coefficients for color scale readability
    coef_lr_capped = pmax(pmin(coef_lr, 2),  -2),
    coef_dm_capped = pmax(pmin(coef_dm, 2),  -2)
  )

# ── Join to county shapefile ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
counties_sf <- counties(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2022) %>%
  mutate(county_id = paste(as.integer(STATEFP),
                           as.integer(COUNTYFP), sep = "_")) %>%
  filter(STUSPS %in% aoi_states) %>%    # or use your own state filter
  st_transform(4326)

states_sf_bg <- states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2022) %>%
  filter(STUSPS %in% aoi_states) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

map_data <- counties_sf %>%
  left_join(county_coefs_wide, by = "county_id")

# ── Shared theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
map_theme <- theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# ── Map 1: Loss ratio coefficient ─────────────────────────────────────────────
p_map_lr <- ggplot() +
  # Insignificant counties: faded
  geom_sf(
    data = map_data %>% filter(!is.na(coef_lr) & !sig_lr),
    aes(fill = coef_lr_capped),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  # Significant counties: full color
  geom_sf(
    data = map_data %>% filter(!is.na(coef_lr) & sig_lr),
    aes(fill = coef_lr_capped),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 1.0
  ) +
  # Counties with no data: grey
  geom_sf(
    data = map_data %>% filter(is.na(coef_lr)),
    fill = "grey85", color = "white", linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = states_sf_bg, fill = NA,
          color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    name     = "Coefficient",
    palette  = "RdBu",
    direction = 1,
    limits   = c(-2, 2),
    na.value = "grey85"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Effect of Lagged Loss Ratio on Enrollment",
    subtitle = paste0("Faded = p > ", sig_level,
                      ";  grey = fewer than ", min_obs, " observations")
  ) +
  map_theme

# ── Map 2: Drought coefficient ────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_map_dm <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = map_data %>% filter(!is.na(coef_dm) & !sig_dm),
    aes(fill = coef_dm_capped),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = map_data %>% filter(!is.na(coef_dm) & sig_dm),
    aes(fill = coef_dm_capped),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 1.0
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = map_data %>% filter(is.na(coef_dm)),
    fill = "grey85", color = "white", linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = states_sf_bg, fill = NA,
          color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    name      = "Coefficient",
    palette   = "RdBu",
    direction = 1,
    limits    = c(-2, 2),
    na.value  = "grey85"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Effect of Lagged Drought Intensity on Enrollment",
    subtitle = paste0("Faded = p > ", sig_level,
                      ";  grey = fewer than ", min_obs, " observations")
  ) +
  map_theme

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(patchwork)

p_combined <- p_map_lr / p_map_dm

png(here("data/outputs/figures/county_coef_maps.png"),
    width  = 1600,
    height = 1800,
    res    = 150)
plot(p_combined)
dev.off()
```
